intent: Many agents, small: a strip of what runs now for a header (row of chips) or a sidebar (stack), with status, activity and a clock.
useWhen: an at-a-glance list of running agents in app chrome
show which agent waits for the person or failed
link from a compact strip to each agent
doNotUseWhen: agents with sub-agent progress and cost — AgentFleet

maxVisible.note: Default 3 (row) or 4 (stack); the rest is "+N" / "View all".

requirements: section named by its heading (label plus count)
items are a list; each names its status in text
with onSelect each item is a button
the +N overflow says how many more
spinner and entry motion use transform and opacity, off under prefers-reduced-motion

doNot: Do not invent a local RunningList, AgentStrip, or ActivityBar
Do not nest an AgentMonitor in the strip
Do not use raw hex for status colors
snippet: <RunningNow items={[{ id: "billing", name: "Billing refactor", activity: "editing invoice.ts", status: "running", elapsed: "02:14" }]} onSelect={openAgent} />
